gifts.title: Your Year In Tides
gifts.about: A whole year of tides at your place, drawn as rings, like the rings of a tree: the year someone was born, the year you married, the year you moved to the coast, or a year still ahead.

gifts.title: Beach Wedding Welcome Sign
gifts.about: A welcome sign for a wedding by the water: the predicted tide at your town or beach on your wedding day, with the time of your ceremony marked on the curve.
